ValidationRule.description: A sale that is Closed Won or Closed Lost can't be reopened or changed: stage, close date, amount, customer, payment mode and name are frozen for everyone. Vehicle and sale price stay editable only for the vehicle change/refund flow (KAN-17).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Closed Lost") ), OR( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISCHANGED(CloseDate), ISCHANGED(Amount), ISCHANGED(AccountId), ISCHANGED(Payment_Mode__c), ISCHANGED(Name) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This sale is closed and can't be changed. If the customer wants something different, create a new sale for them from their account; their details are already saved.
